title: Nonstick But That's About It
text: Nonstick But That's About It. I'm always looking for an upgrade in kitchen equipment. This isn't one of them. I saw this and mistakenly thought it was like the ones you use in hotels. Not even close. Poorly constructed of the finest plastics China has to offer. It heats up faster than my old iron, but the product produced isn't anywhere near the caliber we are used to. The waffles come out easily, but even at the highest setting they are gummy and not crispy. My old Proctor Silex model takes a while to do a waffle, but they come out as light and airy and crispy as a feather. Besides, this thing takes a ton of space to store!

product_metadata.title: Oster Titanium Infused DuraCeramic Flip Waffle Maker, Stainless Steel (CKSTWFBF22-TECO)
features: Flip waffle maker with titanium-infused DuraCeramic nonstick coating lasts 8x longer than standard nonstick coatings
Natural, PTFE- and PFOA-free ceramic coating won't flake or peel and cleans easily
Cooks up to 30% faster, saving time and energy
Simple flip operation for evenly cooked waffles
Adjustable temperature control for light and fluffy or crispy waffles
description: Make delicious waffles just the way you like them using the Oster Titanium Infused DuraCeramic Flip Waffle Maker. This waffle maker is designed with a unique and innovative DuraCeramic nonstick coating that lasts eight times longer and cooks up to 30 percent faster than standard nonstick coatings. The safe and natural ceramic coating is PFOA- and PTFE-free, won't flake or peel, and easily wipes clean, so you can cook foods without worry. This flip waffle maker distributes batter evenly within the plates, cooking your waffles to perfection. Adjustable temperature control lets you accurately set the cooking temperature, so you can easily make light, fluffy waffles or crispy, golden ones. The waffle maker stores vertically, offering efficient, space-saving storage.
